program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (last-nz -1)
                  (dummy (for ((i (range (- ww 1) -1 -1)))
                           (when
                             (and (= last-nz -1) (!= (at g 0 i) 0))
                             (set! last-nz i))))
                  (key-len (+ last-nz 1))
                  (seed-r #f)
                  (seed-c #f)
                  (dummy2 (for* ((r (range 2 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                                (when
                                  (and (not seed-r) (!= (at g r c) 0))
                                  (set! seed-r r)
                                  (set! seed-c c))))
                  (max-d (min (- seed-r 2)
                              (- (- hh 1) seed-r)
                              seed-c
                              (- (- ww 1) seed-c)))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((r (range 2 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (let ((d (max (abs (- r seed-r)) (abs (- c seed-c)))))
                     (when (< d key-len) (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g 0 d)))))
             (for ((c (range (+ max-d 1) ww)))
               (when
                 (!= (hash-ref result (list 0 c) 0) 0)
                 (hash-set! result (list 0 c) 5)))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
